title: Validate registered recording candidates and preservation rules
description: Validate complete current typed candidates while preserving unresolved obligations and the scope and attribution of retained judgments.
inputs: Explicit supported operation, selected project/Change and expected coherent state.
Actor-supplied candidate or verified recovery basis, with declared subject and artifact identities.
outputs: Structurally admissible complete candidate or explicit bounded rejection/conflict; validity supplies no engineering approval.
behavior: Unknown fields or vocabularies, duplicate keys or identities, missing required values, unsupported encodings/versions, mixed stores, dual report representations, and malformed current records reject before authoritative writes.

Every supporting record has an unambiguous identity, owning Change and kind, with explicit applicability wherever the selected contract requires a reliance decision. References resolve exactly one admissible object in the complete candidate; storage-layout adjacency grants no authority and cross-Change fallback cannot repair an unresolved reference.

Supplied scope, subjects, narrative, provenance and decisions are preserved. Adverse evidence and explicit invalidation remain recordable; new success claims must meet the selected contract’s current support requirements.

Omitted issues remain unchanged, and open findings/blockers require explicit attributable disposition. The selected v4 contract permits later compaction and current-assessment replacement without permanent history; v3 retains its finding and immutable-origin rules. Validation must not infer resolution or reviewer judgment.

Reviews and Verifications use distinct closed assessment shapes with explicit scope, governing basis, support and limitations. Final successful Verify requires applicable mandatory review and accepted bases; scoped adverse results can be recorded without inventing missing success prerequisites.

failure_behavior.condition: The requested candidate, expected state or recovery basis cannot be established safely.
failure_behavior.outcome: Return the corresponding bounded rejection, conflict or recovery condition without invented decisions, silent merge or unrelated overwrite.

Reconcile existing use/behavior with current explicit task selection, coherent SQLite outcomes and attributable judgments; no new stakeholder need or runtime qualification is inferred.
